name: Lisabelle no Ma 6 - Rheandl Hen ~Kanata no Shiroi Kage~
original_name: リズベルルの魔6　レアンドル篇～彼方の白影～
source:
"......A catastrophe will come. A dark, terrible disaster....."

Grenn was his father's son, a mech crafter of Rheandle. It was here that swordmaster Anamea Deem asked him to tune a sky-class mech requiring special armor. Guided by a compass, he dreamed of the mystery that awaits. Meanwhile, Deem family daughter Nagia's tendency to get lost in skygazing caused her childhood friend concern-----.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE156766.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“……一场灾难即将来临。一场黑暗、可怕的灾难……”

格伦是他父亲的儿子，莱恩德尔的一名机甲工匠。正是在这里，剑圣阿纳米亚·迪姆要求他调校一台需要特殊装甲的天空级机甲。在指南针的指引下，他梦想着等待着的谜团。与此同时，蒂姆家的女儿娜吉亚在仰望天空时迷失方向，引起了她儿时好友的担忧——。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE156766.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
